title: Best of Banff – 3-Hour Private Tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Your Evening

Evening Itinerary
5 stops · 3 hours · Pure Banff magic

6:00 PM
Hotel Pickup
We pick up your group from your Banff hotel.

6:15 PM
Stop 1 — Lake Minnewanka
Banff's largest lake. 

6:45 PM
Stop 2 — Two Jack Lake
Mirror-like reflections of Mount Rundle. One of the most photographed spots in Banff.

7:15 PM
Stop 3 — Hoodoos Viewpoint
Ancient rock formations towering over the Bow Valley. A unique geo wonder.

7:40 PM
Stop 4 — Surprise Corner
Iconic viewpoint of the Fairmont Banff Springs Hotel framed by the Bow River at sunset.

8:10 PM
Stop 5 — Bow Falls
End the evening at beautiful Bow Falls as the last light fades over the Rockies.

9:00 PM
Return to Hotel
We drop your group back at your hotel. A perfect evening in the Canadian Rockies.
